answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 6 epochs old, anchored at a relic checkpoint. The lagoon chain is verified at intake and onyx publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 6 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Repeating the trick 6 times costs 10 separate deposits and 54 separate proofs of work. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
